column8: Cannot be re-earned against the diffing reference: the disable_log boot patch turns the je at 0x004963e7 into jmp, so the original never calls _fputs for any input. Every arm is a no-op on the original side and a null port matches by construction.

Cannot be re-earned: the disable_log boot patch writes ret (0xc3) at 0x00496400, so the original is a no-op for every input. The port install is also refused by the HookSystem boot-patch guard (kBootPatched 0x00496400), so path2 cannot be live.
